cues: Haloarenes couple with sodium, just like the Wurtz reaction.
Two chlorobenzene molecules with sodium in dry ether lose their chlorines to the sodium and join together, giving biphenyl.
text: Haloarenes couple with sodium, just like the Wurtz reaction. Two chlorobenzene molecules with sodium in dry ether lose their chlorines to the sodium and join together, giving biphenyl. This is the Fittig reaction.
